Name: Bigger Farmhouse Map
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
_Description_

*   Bigger farmhouse map

*   Designed to still have decent compatibility with most other mods

*   I really wanted a square farmhouse layout and an indoor greenhouse area so that's what I did

*   Now updated for 1.6!
_Update notes_

*   Thanks to Lyoko for the update

*   The first two mod images are from the update, the others are from the 1.5 version of the mod but I've left them up because they're so pretty

*   No longer has spouse room stairs
_Compatibility_

*   You can plant crops by default, but if you want to plant fruit trees you need [crops anytime anywhere](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3000) , [planter trees](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11687), or [fruit tree tweaks](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11422)

*   Compatible with Free Love.

*   Doesn't change the cellar, so you can still use cellar mods

*   Should work in multiplayer if everyone has it installed

*   Not mobile compatible

*   You can install this mod mid-save to change the unmodded (vanilla) farmhouse with minimal trouble. But it is recommended to install [NoClip](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900)  in case you need to retrieve items from inside walls
